description: This source file is an extension of the ChannelsSettings class, providing various internal methods and computed properties to manage and display the status, details, and visual styles of different communication channels (e.g., WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, etc.) within a SwiftUI-based application.

methods.name: channelStatus
methods.description: Fetches and decodes the channel status snapshot for a given channel ID and type, returning a decoded object or nil if unavailable.

methods.name: configuredChannelTint
methods.description: Determines the color tint for a channel based on its configuration, error state, and operational status.

methods.name: configuredChannelSummary
methods.description: Returns a summary string indicating whether the channel is configured, running, or not configured.

methods.name: appendProbeDetails
methods.description: Appends detailed status information about a probe to the given lines array, including version, elapsed time, errors, and last activity timestamps.

methods.name: finishDetails
methods.description: Aggregates and formats probe-related details into a single string, or returns nil if no information is available.

methods.name: finishProbeDetails
methods.description: Helper that formats specific probe status information and calls finishDetails to produce a summary string.

methods.name: channelSection
methods.description: Creates a SwiftUI view section for a specific communication channel, with custom content for WhatsApp channels.

methods.name: channelTint
methods.description: Determines the visual tint (color) for a given channel item based on its status.

methods.name: channelSummary
methods.description: Provides a textual summary of a channel’s current state.

methods.name: channelDetails
methods.description: Returns a detailed description string for a channel, including error info and last activity.

methods.name: channelLastCheckText
methods.description: Returns a relative age string indicating when the channel was last checked.

methods.name: channelLastCheck
methods.description: Returns the last check Date for a channel by inspecting its status or activity timestamps.

methods.name: channelHasError
methods.description: Checks whether a channel has encountered an error based on its status.

methods.name: resolveChannelTitle
methods.description: Resolves a human-readable title for a channel ID, with fallback to capitalized ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelDetailTitle
methods.description: Resolves a detailed label for a channel ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelSystemImage
methods.description: Resolves the system image name for a channel ID.

methods.name: channelStatusDictionary
methods.description: Returns a dictionary representing the raw status data for a channel from the snapshot.
